name: discord
description: Discord chat bridge. Mirrors chat.input / chat.response between the brAIn bus and a Discord bot (paste a Developer Portal token to connect — supports DMs and any text channel the bot is in).

chat.input.description: Mirrored to every known Discord channel (except when the message itself came from Discord — loop guard via metadata.platform).

chat.response.description: Brain (or other node) replies (exact-topic flavor used by the default seed).

chat.response.*.description: Brain (or other node) replies with a sub-topic suffix.

bridge.discord.control.description: UI control plane — `{action: connect|disconnect|logout|status}`. Pushed from `system.discord-ui` after the user saves a new bot_token.

action.description: connect: start the Discord client with the stored bot_token. disconnect: stop the client but keep the token on disk. logout: stop and wipe the token from disk. status: re-publish bridge.discord.status + channels.
